Currently, we exhibit works in the motif
of legends in the Unova region.

If you want to see Burgh's paintings,
go to the Pokémon Gym!

Please show me a Pokémon that's
{VAR 0103 0000} type!{VAR BE01}

Oh! You have that type!
I'm inspired!{VAR BE01}
Thank you! As a token of my gratitude,
which one would you like?

One {VAR 0109 0000}!
It's all yours now!{VAR BE01}

Aww. You are the best!
Please come back tomorrow, too!

The Pokémon you chose is not the one
I requested.{VAR BE01}
What I want to paint is a Pokémon that's
{VAR 0103 0000} type!
